column1: # Nothing is stated here. The three files below are the three kinds of claim a
# step makes, and keeping them apart is what lets step 2 make two of the three
# claims in a different voice: it includes the same standing rules and the same
# floor, and *holds* m01.tsv rather than including it, so step 1's six
# requirements become preconditions on step 2's tree instead of a share of step
#   common.tsv   the standing rules -- true of the untouched tree, so a FAIL is
#                a void reading rather than an unmigrated one
#   floor.tsv    the two standing rules whose thresholds are this codebase's
#   m01.tsv      m1..m6, the requirements weights.tsv pays for
